description: Source code for tlRestApi class implementing REST API endpoints for TestLink project, including project, test case, test plan, and execution management.

classes.name: tlRestApi
classes.description: Class providing REST API endpoints for managing test projects, test cases, test plans, test suites, and test executions within TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the API, sets up routes, database connection, and managers for test entities.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates API requests using PHP_AUTH_USER header and sets user context.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns the identity of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves accessible test projects, optionally by ID or name.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Retrieves all test plans for a specified project.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Retrieves latest versions of test cases for a specified project.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project from JSON request body.

methods.name: createTestCaseExecution
methods.description: Creates a test case execution record after validating environment and permissions.

methods.name: checkExecutionEnvironment
methods.description: Validates test plan, build, platform, and test case for execution.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan from JSON request body.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan identified by ID.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite from JSON request body.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case, including default management and relation checks.

methods.name: getUserID
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving user ID from login.

methods.name: createTestCaseDefaultManagement
methods.description: Sets default author ID and steps for a test case object.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Validates test project and suite IDs and their relationship.
